content.comment_body: Can anyone advise on the best load cell (5kg to 25kg range) to use with a [company_name] [product_name]? Your feedback is greatly appreciated. Best regards, [user_name]

While I can't recommend a specific load cell, it's important to note that the analog inputs on [product_name] have a 10-bit resolution (values from 0 to 1000), which may limit measurement accuracy for precise weighing. Modules that interface with a load cell and convert signals to a 0-10V output generally offer much higher resolution. I am unsure of the correct technical term for these modules, but consider this when choosing your solution.
Thank you for sharing your insights. I'll keep your advice in mind. Best regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], Load cells typically output very small voltage signals, in the millivolt range. To read these signals, a specialized module for load cell inputs is needed, often based on a Wheatstone bridge circuit. The [product_name] cannot read small mV values directly; it only accepts 0–10V DC, and there isn't a dedicated load cell module for it. The only practical option is using an external module that manages bridge balancing and converts readings into a 0–10V or 0/4–20mA signal compatible with the [product_name]. However, you will still face the issue of 10-bit resolution, so values will be limited and may need scaling or adjustment for decimal point display. Has anyone implemented such a solution?

In a similar situation, I used a digital instrument from [company_name] that can receive and filter signals from load cells. It's programmable for the output and also serves as a display. I've applied this across over 50 packaging machines. Check the device manual for details.

I've also used a similar module (see: [url]). These modules work reliably, but I'm curious how the load cell's very low output signal (max 2mV/V, usually 0–10mV or 0–20mV) reaches the module without interference. That aspect was surprising to me.

analysis.insight_summary: Users explore the difficulties of integrating load cells (5kg–25kg) with a [company_name] [product_name], focusing on the constraints of its analog inputs, notably the limited 10-bit resolution and inability to process low-mV output signals directly. External modules are considered essential for signal conversion, but concerns remain about the accuracy due to resolution limits.
